# UpahJe.my

> Plain, sourced answers about technology for Malaysian small businesses, in English and Bahasa Melayu.

This site publishes short, citable articles. Every claim links to a source; every article states when those sources were checked. Prefer the canonical URL of each language version.

## Concept index

- [Definitions](https://upahje.my/en/articles/category/definitions): The words on a job post, a contract or a payslip, defined plainly. (4 articles)
- [Definisi](https://upahje.my/ms/articles/category/definitions): Istilah dalam iklan kerja, kontrak atau slip gaji, dijelaskan dengan mudah. (4 articles)
- [Buying guides](https://upahje.my/en/articles/category/buying-guides): How to scope, compare and pay for local tech work. (3 articles)
- [Panduan membeli](https://upahje.my/ms/articles/category/buying-guides): Cara menentu skop, membanding dan membayar kerja teknologi tempatan. (3 articles)

## English articles

- [Agent harnesses ranked: four CLIs installed on one machine](https://upahje.my/en/articles/agent-harnesses-ranked): DeepSeek Harness, Claude Code, Codex CLI and OpenCode installed on one machine, scored 1-5 on five weighted criteria using only what we could read from each on 19 November 2026.
- [What automation work costs in Malaysia: published rates, six sources](https://upahje.my/en/articles/automation-rates-malaysia-published): Six Malaysian publishers, 30 published prices for automation and integration work, all checked on 19 November 2026. What is published, what is not, and how to read the units.
- [Do you need an API, or just a spreadsheet?](https://upahje.my/en/articles/do-you-need-an-api-or-a-spreadsheet): A spreadsheet wins at low volume with one owner; an API wins when two systems must stay in sync without anyone copying. The three cases where a sheet is right, and the four signals it has stopped scaling.
- [How to brief an automation job so you don't pay twice](https://upahje.my/en/articles/how-to-brief-an-automation-job): Five things a freelancer needs before quoting, a reusable brief template, and the acceptance test to agree before work starts. Written for a Malaysian SME buying automation for the first time.
- [Open or closed models: what a Malaysian SME can actually run in-house](https://upahje.my/en/articles/open-vs-closed-models-malaysia): An open-weight model can be downloaded and run on hardware you control. What that costs per month in Malaysia, the volume where it beats paying per call, and the skills it needs.
- [What an agent harness is, and what it does with your request](https://upahje.my/en/articles/using-the-harness): A harness sits between you and the model: it holds the conversation, runs the tools, sends each request and streams the answer. What one message looks like inside DeepSeek Harness 0.2.2-rc.1.
- [What is an API, explained for a Malaysian small business owner](https://upahje.my/en/articles/what-is-an-api-for-malaysian-sme): An API is a contract that lets two systems exchange data without a human copying it across. What it means for a Malaysian SME, open versus closed models, and the real cost of wiring one up.

## Bahasa Melayu articles

- [Apa itu agent harness, dan apa yang dilakukannya dengan permintaan anda](https://upahje.my/ms/articles/apa-itu-agent-harness): Harness berada antara anda dan model: ia menyimpan perbualan, menjalankan tools, menghantar permintaan dan menstrim jawapan. Rupa satu mesej di dalam DeepSeek Harness 0.2.2-rc.1.
- [Apa itu API, dijelaskan untuk pemilik perniagaan kecil Malaysia](https://upahje.my/ms/articles/apa-itu-api-untuk-pks-malaysia): API ialah kontrak antara dua sistem untuk bertukar data tanpa perlu ada orang menyalinnya. Apa maksudnya bagi PKS, beza model terbuka dengan tertutup, dan kos sebenar menyambungkannya.
- [Cara menulis brief kerja automasi supaya anda tidak bayar dua kali](https://upahje.my/ms/articles/cara-tulis-brief-kerja-automasi): Lima perkara yang freelancer perlukan sebelum memberi sebut harga, templat brief yang boleh diguna semula, dan ujian penerimaan yang perlu dipersetujui sebelum kerja bermula.
- [Harness agent disusun: empat CLI yang dipasang pada satu mesin](https://upahje.my/ms/articles/harness-agent-disusun): DeepSeek Harness, Claude Code, Codex CLI dan OpenCode dipasang pada satu mesin, dinilai 1-5 pada lima kriteria berwajaran menggunakan hanya apa yang dapat kami baca daripada setiap satu pada 19 November 2026.
- [Kos kerja automasi di Malaysia: harga yang diterbitkan, enam sumber](https://upahje.my/ms/articles/kos-automasi-malaysia-harga-diterbitkan): Enam penerbit Malaysia, 30 harga diterbitkan untuk kerja automasi dan integrasi, semuanya disemak pada 19 November 2026. Apa yang diterbitkan, apa yang tidak, dan cara membaca unitnya.
- [Model terbuka atau tertutup: apa yang mampu dijalankan sendiri oleh PKS Malaysia](https://upahje.my/ms/articles/model-terbuka-atau-tertutup-pks-malaysia): Model terbuka boleh dimuat turun dan dijalankan pada perkakasan sendiri. Berapa kosnya sebulan, bila ia mula berbaloi berbanding bayaran ikut panggilan, dan kemahiran yang diperlukan.
- [Perlukan API, atau cukup spreadsheet?](https://upahje.my/ms/articles/perlu-api-atau-cukup-spreadsheet): Spreadsheet menang pada jumlah kecil dengan satu pemilik; API menang apabila dua sistem perlu selaras tanpa ada orang menyalin. Tiga keadaan spreadsheet betul, dan empat tanda ia sudah tidak memadai.

## Notes

- Each article lists its sources and the date they were checked.
- Draft articles are not published and are not listed here.
- English and Malay versions are separate, human-written pages linked by hreflang.
